name: io.github.assafbar2/agentswitchboard
description: Search a curated directory of AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic tools, and suggest new listings. Use it to find out whether an agent already exists for a job, which access methods it offers (API, MCP, CLI, browser extension), and where its homepage is.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.title: Search Agents
tools.description: Search the curated Agent Switchboard directory of AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic tools. Filter by category slug, access methods, official (first-party listings from major vendors), verified, and/or auth type; sort by relevance, newest, most skills, or name. Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working. Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified. Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, skills, categories, tags, and provider

access.description: Require ALL of these access methods: api, mcp, cli, browser-extension ("extension" is accepted as an alias of browser-extension)

official.description: Only first-party listings from major vendors (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP)

verified.description: Only Verified listings: checked to work, re-checked monthly

auth.description: Only listings with one of these auth types: none (no key or sign-in needed), apiKey, oauth2, bearer. A listing has one auth type, so several mean any of them

sort.description: Result order. relevance (default): best match first with search text, featured then A→Z without. newest: most recently added first. skills: most skills first. name: A→Z

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination

tools.name: get_agent
tools.title: Get Agent Details

It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified. Featured: set only by the maintainer. tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: All directory categories with live agent counts. Slugs are valid inputs for search_agents.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.title: Submit a Listing
tools.description: Suggest a new listing for the Agent Switchboard directory. This opens a PUBLIC GitHub issue that the maintainer reviews by hand; it does not publish anything. Use it only when the user asks to submit or list a product, after you show them the name, URL, and description you will send and they agree. Call search_agents first: if the product is already listed, tell the user instead. Limited to 5 submissions per hour per caller and one per URL per day.

url.description: The product's own homepage, docs, or GitHub repo (https)

description.description: What it does and who it is for, in plain words (20–1500 characters)

access.description: How agents reach it: api, mcp, cli, browser-extension

contact_email.description: Optional. Sent privately to the maintainer for follow-up, never posted. Only include an address the user gave you for this purpose.
